B_k_action: gamma = (perm p, signs s) acts on the chart by act(gamma, x)_i = s_i * x_{p_i}
carrier: P_7 = union of the unit cubes c + [0,1]^7, c in {0,1}^7, c != (1,...,1) (127 cubes)
chart: facet chart x in [-1/2,1/2]^k: global point = facet centre + sum_i x_i e_{ra[i]}, ra = the k axes != a in increasing order; facet centre = c + (1/2,...,1/2) with coordinate a replaced by c_a + (1 if s = +1 else 0)
facets: exposed unit facets (c, a, s): cube c, normal axis a, side s in (-1,+1), kept iff c + s e_a is not a carrier cube; order: c in itertools.product((0,1), repeat=7) without (1,...,1), then a = 0..6, then s = -1, +1 (896 facets)
key_placement: key (gamma, signed height h_s) on facet f: the solid { facet point act(gamma, q/D + u) + n * sign(h_s) * s * e_a : (u, n) in K0(|h_s|) }, q = (1, ..., k); a bump (h_s > 0) is added to the carrier outside the facet, a dent (h_s < 0) is removed from the carrier inside it
name: S51 sparse 7D chair tile (one key height) -- FINAL, height rescaled to 1/336 (S51/D_proof)
provenance: keys = one H_r-orbit per facet (COMMON.md sparse choice, delta = id) from fgate.Gate(Geom(d), CL) labels; CL = s47/B_shape5d/sets_l7.pkl key CL (408 contacts) for d = 7

reference_key_K0.description: K0(h) = convex hull of the base box prod_i [-w_i, w_i] (in the facet, normal coordinate 0) and the apex (o, h); coordinates (u_1..u_k, n): u = chart offset, n = distance along the apex direction

rescale_provenance.rule: every signed height h_s replaced by sign(h_s) * new_height; K0 apex height likewise; nothing else changed
